name: Kimi K3
description: Kimi K3 is Kimi's flagship 2.8T open-source model built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and Attention Residuals. It features native visual understanding for images and video, a 1M-token context window with automatic caching, and an always-on thinking mode designed for frontier intelligence scenarios like long-horizon coding and knowledge work.
keyFeatures: Built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes)
Stable LatentMoE framework efficiently activates 16 out of 896 experts
1M-token context window with automatic context caching
Native visual understanding supporting images and video files
Always-on thinking mode with configurable reasoning effort
